answer.reason: Genesis 11:31-32 tell what Terah did (set out from Ur for Canaan with his family) and how he ended (died in Haran), beyond the summary's relations and residence.

clauses.english: took Abram, Lot and Sarai from Ur of the Chaldees to go into the land of Canaan
clauses.quote: they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan

clauses.english: died in Haran at two hundred and five years old
clauses.quote: the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran

doubts: Joshua 24:2 says Terah served other gods; left out as it is a brief remark, not an event of his story.
Luke 3:34 (Thara) and 1 Chronicles 1:26 only list him in genealogies, so they were not used.
